title: Astonishers
overview: The reporters call them the 'Guardians of Tomorrow’,  the people call them the ‘ASTONISHERS’. The Man of Tomorrow, The Dark Knight, The Man Without Fear and your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man must confront their grief and stop the renewed Dark Lord of the Sith DARTH VADER and his group of Watchmen from reshaping Earth and its people to his will.
